title: Correction to: Could hair cortisol in free-ranging cattle be a proxy of wolf predation patterns?
content: This is a correction to: Marta Rafael, Eliana Fonseca, Nuno Santos, Mónia Nakamura, Could hair cortisol in free-ranging cattle be a proxy of wolf predation patterns?, Conservation Physiology, Volume 14, Issue 1, 2026, coag002, https://doi.org/10.1093/conphys/coag002.
